landing.eyebrow: AOEhub (Alpha Omega Education) — for homeschool, unschool, and school families alike
landing.h1:
Education isn't something you copy.
It's something you walk.
landing.subhead: A free home for the philosophy, the honest experience, and the curriculum behind education — shared by families who started the walk before you, for families just starting now.
landing.browsePost: and the Experience Board — no account needed to look around.
landing.signupPre: Want to download a file, post something, or leave a comment?
landing.signupStrong: Sign up or log in — it's free.
landing.pullquote: "Education is an atmosphere, a discipline, and a life."
landing.taglineSmall: The Experience Board and File Board are always free · Built by those who've walked this path, are walking it now, and are just starting.
landing.marketplaceNote: Heads-up: we plan to add a marketplace in a later update, where members can buy and sell. The Experience Board and File Board will stay free. We work hard to prevent scams, but we can't guarantee none will happen.

landing.expTitle: Real stories, and the philosophy behind them
landing.expDesc: What worked, what didn't, and what they'd do differently — plus honest reflections on why we educate at all, from the Bible, Charlotte Mason <note>(a 19th-century educator known for her living-books, nature-study approach)</note>, Karl Witte <note>(a 19th-century writer known for his early-education philosophy)</note>, and everyone here who has their own thoughts to share. This isn't just the founders' philosophy — it's everybody's, filed under its own tag so it's easy to find.

landing.fileDesc: Download, use, and remix anything — always at no cost, and always credited back to whoever made it first.

welcome.exploring.title: Welcome — glad you're here
welcome.exploring.body: Since you're just starting to explore this, a couple of good places to begin: try the Philosophy tag right here on the Experience Board for the "why," or the File Board's beginner picks for the "how."
welcome.inSchool.title: Welcome — glad you're here
welcome.inSchool.body: AOEhub isn't just for homeschoolers — plenty of school families use it too, for extra practice material, a different way of thinking about learning, or just to see what else is out there. The Philosophy tag here on the Experience Board is a good place to see what this community actually believes, and the File Board has plenty worth browsing either way.
welcome.homeschooling.title: Welcome — glad to have you
welcome.homeschooling.body: You're new to the hub, not to homeschooling — so you've probably already got something worth sharing. Post about what's working (or isn't) on the Experience Board, and the File Board is full of curriculum other homeschooling families have already put through its paces.
welcome.unschooling.title: Welcome — glad to have you
welcome.unschooling.body: You're new to the hub, not to unschooling — this community values that perspective a lot. Share how it's actually going for you on the Experience Board, and check the File Board for resources other unschoolers have already found useful.

points.title: How points work
points.intro: Points come from real activity on the File Board and Experience Board:
points.view: {n} point per view (counted once per person per day)
points.comment: {n} points per question or comment someone leaves on your post
points.remix: {n} points when someone remixes your file
points.note: Search ranking uses a compressed version of these numbers, so one huge hit doesn't bury everything else — but your profile total is always a simple, honest sum.
pins.title: From verified voices
pins.intro: You can pin one of your posts and one of your files to the top of each board. It is only ever your own choice. If a reviewer adds a notice or a warning to a pinned item, it is unpinned and stays unpinned until you pin it again.
